about.title: Who will be treating you
about.lead: Before deciding on a procedure, it makes sense to know who performs it and what their training is. It's all here — and it's verifiable.
about.verifyLicense: Verify license in Mexico's National Registry of Professionals
about.verifyNote: Medical licenses in Mexico are publicly searchable. I'd encourage you to check mine — and anyone else's who is going to inject you.
about.approachBody: Every proposal starts with an assessment. I review what you're looking for, what is reasonable to expect in your case, and what risks are involved. If the procedure you're interested in isn't right for you, or if I don't think you need it, I'll say so — even if that means you don't book anything.
about.internationalBody: If you're coming from abroad: Mexican medical training is credentialed through the cédula profesional, a number issued by the Ministry of Public Education that anyone can verify online. It's the functional equivalent of a medical license in your country.
